name: WebCatalog
description: WebCatalog’s reviewed updater wires electron-updater events and presents a restart choice after an update is available; the source also has a silent-update state and does not establish a uniformly user-gated download policy. Build metadata and delegated signing enforcement remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly recovered snapshot; historical release behavior is not reverified.
Released artifacts and electron-updater signing enforcement remain external.
